## About
Paint Master of Texas is a painting crew based on Clinton St in Conroe. One reviewer wrote about Aldo and his team painting a whole house in several different colors and staining white oak cabinetry.
We handle the work that makes a room feel finished: walls, ceilings, doors, trim, custom cabinets, built-ins and mantles. Before the paint comes out, floors and surfaces get covered, dents get patched and worn trim gets repaired.
Homeowners have given us a 4.9 rating on Google from 61 reviews. Give us a call and tell us what you have in mind.

## Services
- Interior painting: Walls, ceilings, doors and trim, done with care inside your home.
- Cabinet painting: Custom cabinets, plus built-ins and mantles.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 7 AM to 6 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 407 Clinton St, Conroe, TX 77301.

Q: Do you paint built-ins and mantles?
A: Yes. One reviewer had us paint their custom cabinets, then brought us back for a living room built-in and the mantle.
